title: Senior Presales Operations Analyst
description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

• Experience navigating ambiguity, bringing a clear point of view, and taking ownership beyond the immediate task.

title: State Government Growth & Regulatory Board Partnerships (Remote, US)
description:
Propelus ® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.
As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.
About The Role:
We are seeking a relationship-first professional to serve as our Regulatory Partnership Director. You will build trust with state healthcare regulatory boards and agencies to support the growth and expansion of Propelus This role is grounded in credibility; taking the time to understand stakeholder priorities and operational challenges, and integrating that insight into the CE Broker solution, and ultimately delivering measurable value.
This is a consultative partnership role , not a traditional high-volume sales position. Your work will focus on earning trust within government environments, navigate multi-year decision cycles with patience, and maintaining the discipline needed to move opportunities forward.
You will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned state partners, guiding them on how to improve operational efficiency and strengthen compliance.
What You'll Do:

•
Execute Relationship Cadence: Maintain a consistent and proactive communication schedule with assigned state regulatory boards and agencies. Invest time to understand local missions and constraints.

• You will drive active, values-focused conversations about creating operational efficiency, new ways to modernize government, and support the regulatory boards in their core mission and supporting healthcare pros in their daily needs.

• Tactical Solution Mapping: Translate the capabilities of our product, CE Broker, into specific outcomes tied to agency efficiency and public protection. Deliver business cases and proposals that address the immediate needs of board staff and leadership.

•
Manage Opportunities Through the Lifecycle: Advance opportunities using a consultative approach. Create momentum by aligning our implementation timelines with agency deadlines and strategic plans.

• You will operate with a thoughtful urgency, knowing when and how to navigate strategic opportunities to close deals in complex environments.

• Regulatory Knowledge Application: Maintain an up-to-date understanding of state licensing frameworks and Continuing Education (CE) compliance for your assigned territories and professions.

• Pipeline Coordination: Maintain a healthy and accurate pipeline by proactively surfacing new opportunities within existing or prospective accounts. Leverage industry trends and new regulation requirements to identify where Propelus can solve emerging compliance gaps.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless transition from contract signature to "go-live."

• Operational Discipline: Maintain accurate visibility into opportunities via CRM (Salesforce). Bring a structure to forecasting and follow-through to ensure no stakeholder request is left unanswered.

We Would Like You To Have:

• 3-5+ years of experience at the State level working directly with regulatory boards, healthcare regulatory environment, or a related field.

• Proven track record of building and maintaining relationships within state agencies and/or licensing boards, with an ability to build rapport at both the operational and leadership levels.

• Project management mindset that can build pipelines, nurture and close complex deals, and coordinate complex RFPs and contract renewals, ensuring all technical and compliance requirements are met.

title: People Administrator - 6m FTC
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  

As a part of The Brandtech Group , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  

Role: People Administrator - 6 Month Fixed Term Contract

Location: London, United Kingdom

About the role:  

The People Administrator is a specialist within Oliver's People team, responsible for comprehensive HR operations across UK and EMEA. This is a role for someone who brings solid HR foundations and wants to grow within a dynamic, international team. You'll manage the full range of employee lifecycle documentation, support People Partners across core cyclical activities, and take ownership of projects as your expertise grows. Alongside the day-to-day, you'll help ensure our processes are globally aligned, audit-ready, and continuously improving.

What you will be doing:  

 

HR Operations & Administration

• Manage employee documentation across the full lifecycle - offer letters, contracts, contract variations, and all relevant correspondence.

• Coordinate new starter administration, inductions, and background or reference checks.

• Ensure right-to-work and data protection compliance across UK and EMEA markets.

• Continuously refine internal workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and all lifecycle events.

• Guide employees and managers through family leave processes, including maternity, paternity, and adoption.

• Partner with People Partners and cross-functional teams to provide timely administrative support.

• Support core cyclical activities, including performance appraisals, compensation planning, and HR audits.

• Contribute actively to team meetings, sharing knowledge and collaborating across the wider People team.

• Lead on assigned projects with support from the People Operations Partner.

Payroll & Analytics

• Action monthly payroll data transfers to People Operations and Finance, ensuring complete accuracy.

• Run reports and analyse HR metrics to deliver insights and support ad-hoc projects.

• Solid, practical knowledge of HR processes and UK employment law; familiarity with EMEA markets is a plus.

• Experience administering HR documentation and managing the employee lifecycle end to end.

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once.

• Comfortable working with HRIS platforms; experience with Sage is advantageous.

• Clear, professional communication and a collaborative, service-oriented approach - you handle sensitive matters with care and discretion.

• Confidence drawing insights from HR data, reports, and metrics.

title: DBA Community Lead
description:
O nas
Digital Business Alliance (DBA) to społeczność ponad 200 founderów i liderów firm technologicznych w Polsce , którzy wspólnie tworzą przestrzeń do wymiany doświadczeń, współpracy i wzajemnego wsparcia.
Organizujemy wydarzenia w największych miastach, łączymy ludzi wokół idei rozwoju i technologii, a także pomagamy firmom skalować się dzięki partnerstwom i wymianie wiedzy.
Naszym celem jest budowanie silnej sieci przedsiębiorców, którzy razem kształtują przyszłość polskiej branży technologicznej.
Rola
Szukamy osoby, która poprowadzi i rozwinie społeczność DBA - zadba o komunikację, relacje między członkami, aktywność w kanałach i wsparcie lokalnych chapterów (Warszawa, Kraków, Wrocław, Katowice, Łódź, Gdynia).
To rola dla kogoś, kto łączy strategiczne myślenie o rozwoju społeczności z codzienną operacyjną skutecznością - potrafi planować, ale też działać.
Requirements
Twoje zadania
🔹 1. Komunikacja i publikacje

• Samodzielne tworzenie i publikacja treści na kanałach DBA (LinkedIn, Slack, newsletter, Luma).

• Przygotowywanie angażujących postów, zaproszeń i aktualności.

• Współtworzenie newslettera DBA - zbieranie historii, inicjatyw i inspiracji od członków społeczności.

• Dbanie o spójny ton komunikacji i wizerunek DBA.

🔹 2. Koordynacja i wsparcie wydarzeń

• Współpraca z lokalnymi Headami Chapterów w całej Polsce.

• Pomoc w organizacji śniadań, meetupów i spotkań founderskich.

• Wsparcie promocji wydarzeń (posty, mailing, komunikacja w Slacku i na Luma).

• Działania administracyjne: rejestracje, zaproszenia, follow-upy.

🔹 3. Relacje i zaangażowanie społeczności

• Onboarding nowych członków (Slack, newsletter, powitanie i kontakt).

• Aktywizacja członków - inicjowanie dyskusji, poleceń, współprac.

• Moderacja Slacka i odpowiadanie na wiadomości społeczności.

🔹 4. Partnerstwa i współpraca z firmami

• Wsparcie komunikacji z partnerami, sponsorami i prelegentami.

• Pomoc przy działaniach promocyjnych i partnerskich.

🔹 5. Operacje i narzędzia

• Aktualizacja kalendarza wydarzeń, Lumy i materiałów w Notion.

• Przygotowywanie podsumowań wydarzeń, raportów i list uczestników.

• Wykorzystywanie narzędzi (Slack, Notion, Canva, Luma, ClickUp, Substack, OpenAI) do usprawniania codziennej pracy.

🔹 6. Raportowanie i feedback

• Zbieranie danych o aktywności społeczności i wydarzeniach.

• Regularne raportowanie wyników (liczba uczestników, wydarzeń, nowych członków).

• Analiza feedbacku i rekomendacje usprawnień.

Profil idealnej osoby
Must have:

• Doświadczenie w community buildingu, komunikacji lub marketingu B2B.

• Świetna organizacja pracy i samodzielność.

• Umiejętność pisania angażujących treści po polsku (mile widziana znajomość angielskiego).

• Znajomość narzędzi: Slack, Notion, Canva, Luma, LinkedIn, Substack, ClickUp, Google Drive.

• Otwartość, inicjatywa i pozytywna energia - naturalna chęć do angażowania ludzi.

Nice to have:

• Doświadczenie w pracy z firmami technologicznymi lub software house’ami.

• Znajomość środowiska startupowego.

• Umiejętność korzystania z AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva Magic Studio).

Co oferujemy

• Możliwość realnego wpływu na rozwój jednej z najciekawszych społeczności biznesowo-technologicznych w Polsce.

• Pracę z inspirującymi founderami i liderami z branży.

• Elastyczną współpracę (ok. 80 godzin miesięcznie, z perspektywą pełnego etatu).

• Wynagrodzenie zależne od doświadczenia.

• Pracę w pełni zdalną z okazjonalnymi spotkaniami podczas wydarzeń DBA.

Highlights
If you are a passionate technologist who is ready to take the next step and build something lasting, we encourage you to apply.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
Who We Are:
Yoga Alliance is the largest nonprofit membership association of yoga professionals, practitioners, and advocates around the globe. We believe if more people practice yoga, the better the world will be. We’re here to amplify the power of yoga and to make it accessible to anyone wherever they are, under whatever circumstances by:

• Uplifting the transformative power of yoga,

• Surfacing and reducing barriers to the practice, and

• Building, engaging, and supporting the yoga community.

Our member-driven community is a diverse collective of wisdom holders, yoga educators, and teachers expanding their expertise; a welcoming space for those newly exploring yoga; a place for seasoned practitioners to deepen their practice; and a supportive hub where community leaders, organizations, and businesses can leverage yoga for social good.
At the core of Yoga Alliance lies a profound commitment to our people. Here, every team member is empowered to lead, innovate, dream, create, and grow. Diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility and belonging guide our way of being in work and in working with each other. We champion a culture of collaboration, where learning from failures is as valued as achieving success. Together, we challenge the status quo and push the boundaries of what is possible.
About the Role:
Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience Yoga Alliance is seeking a Salesforce Engineer to join our team.
Salesforce is the backbone of how we serve our members ​-- it holds​ their ​critical information and powers credentialing, membership, and communications. ​ Yoga Alliance is adding this newly created role to ​its team to give the platform a dedicated in-house owner who can strengthen and grow ​Salesforce over time. Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience, this role will partner cross-functionally with internal teams and ​externally with the implementation partner to ​ensure the Salesforce environment​ is reliable and stable, ​as well as manage day-to-day requests from members and staff, and help ​deliver the improvements on ​the product roadmap.
What You Will Do:
Administration and Configuration

• Own incident response during renewals, launches, and peak periods, making time-sensitive calls and coordinating fixes with the external partner when needed.

• Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles, and license assignments across the organization

• Build and maintain declarative automation with Flow, validation rules, and approval processes.

• Configure objects, fields, page layouts, record types, and Lightning App pages.

• Build and maintain CRM and operational reports and dashboards: membership records, case volume, renewals, and internal team dashboards.

• Maintain data quality across records through deduplication, standardization, and ongoing hygiene.

• Work through the support and enhancement backlog, prioritizing the highest-impact tickets first.

Development

• Write, test, and maintain Apex (triggers, classes, batch and scheduled jobs) where configuration alone is not enough.

• Build Lightning Web Components for custom interfaces.

• Build and configure member portal experiences on Experience Cloud within the product and UX direction set by the Director of Digital Experience.

• Support and maintain the platform's integrations over REST and SOAP APIs: Absorb LMS (SSO enrollment and completion sync), Stripe and Blackthorn payments, Marketing Cloud journey triggers, and Pendo.

• Write unit tests that meet Salesforce's 75% minimum, with higher coverage on business-critical logic.

• Run deployments and sandbox refreshes following the release schedule and environment strategy set by the Director of Digital Experience and the external implementation partner.

Collaboration and Delivery

• Own user acceptance testing and post-launch stabilization across a launch-heavy roadmap, including participating in UAT cycles, triaging defects, and resolving the post-launch backlog after each release.

title: Junior Marketing & Campaign Coordinator
description:
We are one of the fastest-growing private youth sports operators in the GTA and Florida. We delivery high-quality, structured sports programming across multiple locations, with a focus on fun, skills development, and exceptional customer experiences.
This is an entry-level role for someone who has foundational knowledge of email or digital marketing and wants to develop deep expertise in lifecycle campaigns, automation, and data-driven optimization. You will work side by side with the Director of Marketing, building real skills in platforms like Twilio and SendGrid while contributing to campaigns that directly impact customer acquisition and retention.
If you are analytical, curious, detail-oriented, and excited about how data and messaging come together to drive results - we want to meet you.
WHY JOIN US
We are a growing company in the sports industry, and our marketing team is at the core of our expansion. This role is an opportunity to go beyond sending emails - you will learn the strategy, the technology, and the data behind lifecycle marketing at a company that moves fast and values results.

• Mentorship from experienced marketers and direct access to senior leadership.

• Hands-on work with enterprise platforms (Twilio, SendGrid) from day one.

• A culture that rewards curiosity, precision, and ownership.

• Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangement.

• A real growth path toward a full Lifecycle Marketing Specialist or Marketing Analyst role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Campaign Execution & Support

• Assist in building, scheduling, QAing, and launching email and SMS campaigns using Twilio and SendGrid under senior supervision.

• Help set up and QA automated lifecycle flows including onboarding sequences, re-engagement campaigns, retention triggers, and other lifecycle marketing initiatives.

• Support the management of audience lists, segmentation criteria, suppression files, and workflow documentation.

• Assist in preparing and formatting email templates in collaboration with the design team.

• Coordinate campaign timelines, internal deliverables, and marketing calendars to ensure campaigns launch on schedule.

• Maintain organized libraries of marketing assets, templates, and campaign documentation.

Testing & Performance Tracking

• Support A/B test setup and help document results for subject lines, CTAs, and content variants.

• Assist with campaign testing, tracking, and reporting across email and SMS channels.

• Compile and maintain performance reports tracking key metrics including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, engagement, and unsubscribes.

• Assist in identifying trends in campaign data and flagging opportunities for optimization and process improvements.

Compliance & Operations

• Help ensure all campaigns comply with applicable regulations including CASL, CAN-SPAM, and GDPR.

• Assist with list hygiene tasks including managing bounces, opt-outs, and suppression lists.

• Maintain documentation of campaign workflows, platform settings, operational processes, and process guides.

• Support ongoing improvements to marketing processes and operational workflows.

Collaboration

• Work closely with the Director of Marketing and senior team members to align on campaign priorities and goals.

• Coordinate with marketing, design, and content teams to ensure campaigns are executed accurately, assets are delivered on time, and messaging remains on brand.

• Participate in team meetings, contribute ideas, and ask questions.

Requirements
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Up to 1-2 years of experience in email marketing, digital marketing, or related roles (internships and relevant coursework count).

• Basic familiarity with email marketing concepts: deliverability, segmentation, open rates, click-through rates.

• Comfortable working with data and digital tools; not afraid of dashboards or spreadsheets.

• Strong attention to detail: you notice what others miss and take quality seriously.

title: Senior Payroll Specialist - 8 month FTC
description:
Fixed-Term Contract | Remote, Australia

Ocado Group is a UK-based company and one of the world's largest dedicated online grocery retailers. Through our innovative Ocado Smart Platform ("OSP"), we provide advanced robotics and automation technology to grocery partners globally. In Australia, our technology powers highly automated Customer Fulfilment Centres supporting our local partner, Coles.

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to join our Australian People team on a fixed-term contract, commencing as soon as possible through to July 2027.

Ocado is currently undertaking a global payroll transformation, transitioning towards a shared services model. During this period, you’ll provide continuity and senior payroll expertise for our Australian business, ensuring payroll continues to be delivered accurately, on time and in line with Australian requirements.

As our senior local payroll subject matter expert, you’ll own Australian payroll delivery and navigate complex matters including Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards, annualised salaries, employee entitlements and time and attendance.

This isn’t a purely transactional payroll role. You’ll also help identify risks, strengthen controls, manage external providers and support the transition of Australian payroll into our future shared services model, including knowledge transfer to future delivery teams.

This role can be based remotely anywhere in Australia. Ideally, you’ll be Melbourne-based or able to attend our Truganina site for a small amount of training and knowledge transfer during the first month or so, generally no more than a couple of consecutive days at a time. Following this initial period, the role can be completely remote.

The day to day for a Senior Payroll Specialist may involve:

• Delivering accurate and timely Australian payroll, including reviewing calculations, outputs and reconciliations.

• Managing complex payroll transactions, discrepancies, over/underpayments and employee queries.

• Providing expert advice on Australian payroll legislation, Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards and employee entitlements.

• Supporting compliance reconciliations, including annualised salaries, and implementing payroll changes and back payments.

• Overseeing time and attendance inputs and resolving exceptions with operational teams.

• Managing external payroll and system providers, validating outputs and driving issues through to resolution.

• Maintaining payroll controls, audit evidence, governance reporting and identifying payroll risks or control gaps.

• Supporting the transition to our future shared services model through testing, validation, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.

About You:

We’re looking for an experienced payroll professional who knows Australian payroll inside and out, enjoys solving complex problems and is comfortable working autonomously.

You’ll ideally have:

• Senior-level end-to-end Australian payroll experience.

• Strong knowledge of Australian payroll legislation and statutory obligations.

• Experience interpreting Enterprise Agreements and/or Modern Awards and applying employee entitlements.

• Strong experience with payroll reconciliations, complex discrepancies, governance and controls.

• Experience managing external payroll providers and confidently challenging outputs where required.

• Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, including reconciliations and remuneration modelling.

• Experience supporting payroll implementation, transformation or service delivery change.

• Strong analytical, stakeholder management and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

Experience with annualised salary arrangements, time and attendance systems, Workday or another enterprise HRIS, or transitioning payroll into a shared services environment would be highly regarded.

title: Senior Hardware Systems Engineer
description:

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As an Senior Hardware Systems Engineer within EverPure’s EXA Hardware Engineering organization, you will serve as a primary technical authority driving the architectural vision, end-to-end design, and system-level validation of our next-generation enterprise and cloud-scale storage platforms.

In this principal-level role, you will define the technology roadmap that bridges deep silicon/board-level hardware innovation with complex, multi-node cloud execution. You will establish design patterns, set high-speed and power/thermal benchmarks, and lead technical strategy across internal platform software teams, cross-functional executives, and global OEM/ODM/JDM partners. By defining next-generation server architectures, rack-scale power/thermal strategies, and zero-downtime resilience models, you will ensure EverPure maintains its industry-leading edge in storage performance and platform reliability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

•
Architectural Leadership & Platform Strategy: Define and own the end-to-end multi-generational hardware roadmap for enterprise storage platforms. Drive architectural trade-off decisions across compute (x86/ARM), memory subsystems, DPUs, high-speed fabrics (PCIe Gen 5/6, CXL), and media technologies to maximize storage density, performance per watt, and TCO.

•
JDM/ODM Governance & System Design: Lead system-level HW design reviews (schematics, layout, power tree design, thermal topology) across global OEM/ODM/JDM partners. Establish technical standards, engineering requirements documents (ERDs), and design guidelines to ensure flawless vendor execution.

•
Validation Strategy & Framework Architecture: Architect overall hardware quality frameworks, comprehensive validation strategies, and advanced diagnostic models spanning parametric, functional, electrical, and full-stack software/firmware integration. Establish automated telemetry, stress-testing paradigms (e.g., FIO, SPEC, custom IO engines), and gating criteria for tier-0 production releases.

•
Escalated Debug & Failure Analysis Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex, systemic hardware, signal integrity, and storage-node failures. Lead dynamic task forces across hardware, firmware, software, and silicon vendors to drive root-cause analysis (RCA) and long-term corrective action (CA) for high-impact edge cases.

•
Test Automation & Tooling Infrastructure: Drive the architecture and adoption of automated test frameworks (Python/Bash) for hardware validation, L10 device-level, and L11 rack-level platform stability, continuously raising the bar for test coverage and cycle time reduction.

•
Cross-Functional & Ecosystem Influence: Partner closely with executive engineering leadership, software architects, platform design, and network infrastructure teams to ensure tight HW/FW/SW co-design. Champion systemic improvements in reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS).

title: Research Scientist, Data Analysis
description:
About Arbor Neuroscience 
(formerly Forest Neurotech)
Arbor is a nonprofit research organization working on one of the hardest open problems in clinical neuroscience: how to change brain circuits by design.
Millions of people with depression, chronic pain, and other brain disorders have no treatment that works. Modulating activity in the brain circuits underlying their symptoms - with electrical stimulation, focused ultrasound, or magnetic stimulation - can work spectacularly well. But it doesn't work reliably, and we can't predict who it will help.
That's what Arbor aims to fix. The starting point is a new class of experiment: intervene, measure how the circuit responds, track the symptom, and repeat in the same individual over months. We’re building the necessary experimental platform. It currently includes the Forest 1 ultrasound system, which works like a wearable functional MRI, but with higher resolution. The system images activity across large brain volumes, including deep brain structures, and will soon stimulate as well. We are also adding electrode-based interfaces in animal studies. From these data, we'll build models to make neuromodulation predictable.
Arbor is a Focused Research Organization within the Convergent Research family, and the new name for Forest Neurotech. We're a mission-focused nonprofit, doing multidisciplinary translational work that doesn't fit in a lab or on a company roadmap. We have the funding to run the first phase, and we're a small team - the people we hire now will shape what Arbor becomes.

title: Durable Finance Manager, NatureVest
description:
The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is the leading conservation organization working to make a positive impact around the world in more than 72 countries, all 50 United States, and your backyard. Founded in 1951, the mission of The Nature Conservancy is to conserve the lands and waters on which all life depends. One of our core values is our commitment to diversity. Therefore, we are committed to a globally diverse and culturally competent workforce. For more information, please visit
NatureVest is the impact investment unit of The Nature Conservancy. NatureVest’s vision is a world where financial markets value and integrate natural capital into business and investment decisions as part of creating a sustainable, equitable and more efficient economy. The Durable Finance Team within NatureVest is responsible for scoping and designing financial strategies for Project Finance for Permanence (PFP) deals. PFPs integrate philanthropic, public and private capital into a transaction with a single closing agreement. As a member of the Enduring Earth Coalition, TNC uses PFPs to sustainably finance long-term conservation initiatives and protected areas.
The Durable Finance Manager will lead the Finance workstream for assigned PFP deals that includes (i) developing the PFP financial model; (ii) preparing and executing finance workshops with government and other stakeholders, and (iii) assisting in the collection of technical inputs and consultations in the design of sustainable finance mechanisms (SFM). The Durable Finance Manager will work collaboratively with complex, cross-functional project teams and key stakeholders, notably TNC country and regional teams and the Global PFP team, to ensure the successful closing of PFP transactions.
This position reports to the Director of Durable Finance within the Financial Advisory Team. The location for this position is flexible within countries where The Nature Conservancy is a registered NGO and has an established office, with working hours aligned with PST (±3 hours). This position is not eligible for relocation or immigration assistance.
This is a two-year term position with opportunity for extension based on funding availability and performance.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
The Durable Finance Manager will be responsible for the development and implementation of one or several projects at a time within our portfolio of PFP projects. They are primarily responsible for overseeing the financial strategy of the PFP, which includes building flexible and transparent financial models (including the incorporation of different types of capital), assessment and design of SFMs, supporting due diligence and risk assessments, and participating in the development of internal and external information memoranda. SFMs may include various fiscal policy-based instruments such as fees, taxes, and levies; conservation finance tools like Payment for Ecosystem Services and carbon credit sales; and some conventional finance instruments such as intermediated debt. To create alignment with key stakeholders, the Project Manager will support the development of and participate in planning meetings with government ministries, project partners, and relevant community stakeholders. The Manager will also be an integral member of PFP teams - the cross functional groups responsible for developing and implementing a given PFP. As such, the Project Manager will develop the finance materials, recommendations, and presentations to support all stages of PFP development.
RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

• In close partnership with in-country and global teams, develop and advance financial strategies for PFP deals.

• Manage and implement complex project work plans, including coordinating sustainable finance workstreams, defining deliverables, setting deadlines, and ensuring accountability.

• Coordinate with project directors and other staff within TNC teams (global strategy teams, regions, etc.) to ensure alignment of objectives and joint pursuit of out

title: Head of Brand
description:
We are hiring a Head of Brand to own how Pairs shows up in the world. The brand, the content behind it, the video we put out, and the small team that makes it with you.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

You own the brand. What Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the image a founder or investor meets before they ever talk to us. You set the strategy and you run it. Most weeks that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You run the story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest through to the final cut, and you cut video yourself. There is a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly one, and a quarterly report we want the category to quote. Paid comes later, once we turn it on, and you own the brief behind every campaign. You also get a team, VC Content Interns who live in this space, write daily, and grow into full-time seats under you. You report to the co-founders, strategize with them, and get real creative freedom.

This is a player-coach seat and both halves are real. People who stopped writing and editing when they got their first team will not enjoy this. Neither will someone who has never had anyone reporting to them, though we will hear the case.

All of it is aimed at one thing. When a founder or an investor asks ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google how raising capital works and who to raise with, we want Pairs quoted back, and we want what gets quoted to be good.

What you will own

- Positioning, voice and look, held consistent everywhere from the site to the feed to the newsroom.

- Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, the newsletter on our site, the monthly one, and the quarterly report. You write them and you ship them.

- Founder and investor story shoots, from booking and prep through shoot day to the edit, with you cutting.

- Sponsorships and retargeting, planned and measured against inbound.

- VC Content Interns you brief, edit and grow into full-time hires.

- Content structured so AI answer engines and journalists quote us, with share of voice tracked and SEO fundamentals underneath.

You are a fit if you

- Have built and run a brand end to end that we can open: a named brand where you set the voice, made the content, ran the channels, and know the before and after numbers from memory.

- Still make it yourself. You write the posts, cut the video, direct the shoot. When we ask what you made versus what you briefed, the answer is specific.

- Have managed makers: a small team, freelancers, or interns, and grown at least one of them into a bigger job.

- Write at a high bar in a restrained register, and can point at published work longer than a caption.

- Have run paid for a brand, sponsorships and retargeting included, or owned the brief and the results while someone else ran the hands.

- Know how AI answer engines and journalists pick what to cite, and have shipped work with that reader in mind. SEO fundamentals are assumed.

- Can take one piece that outperformed and explain exactly why, and one that flopped and what you changed.

- Bonus: you already live in the founder and VC corner of the internet, a personal following among founders or investors, podcast or newsletter production, on-camera comfort.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours, because that is when this audience is online. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct access to the co-founders, real creative freedom, a film library already on disk, a vide

title: Principal Database Engineer
description:
Job Description:
The Principal Database Engineer (DBE) is a senior technical leader responsible for the architecture, automation, performance, and operational excellence of NextGen's enterprise database platforms supporting cloud-first healthcare applications. This role bridges deep database engineering with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to build highly available, scalable, secure, and observable data platforms across public cloud environments.

• Define, architect, evolve and govern highly available, resilient, and secure enterprise database platforms across cloud environments (AWS, GCP).

• Lead the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle management of Microsoft SQL Server platforms while driving enterprise-wide migrations and modernization initiatives toward PostgreSQL and cloud-native database services.

• Design and develop automated frameworks for database provisioning, patching, backup validation, failover testing, and routine maintenance using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management.

• Partner with Platform Engineering to design and implement robust database release automation, CI/CD pipelines, schema versioning, and environment standardization.

• Collaborate with application development teams to optimize database design, query performance, schema evolution, and deployment strategies for cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.

• Establish comprehensive database observability standards, implementing telemetry, logging, proactive alerting, and performance analytics across all database environments.

• Define and improve database reliability objectives, recovery strategies, and operational readiness practices.

• Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive permanent corrective actions following major database production incidents, establishing post-mortem reviews to mitigate future risks.

• Author enterprise engineering standards, reusable automation modules, and comprehensive technical documentation to reduce operational complexity and improve platform consistency.

• Align database technology roadmaps with business goals in partnership with engineering leadership.

• Continuously evaluate emerging databases and data-tier technologies to recommend architectural improvements that enhance long-term reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.

• Serve as the primary technical authority for database architecture and cloud migrations, mentoring junior and mid-level engineers while influencing technical strategy across the engineering organization.

• Support strategic cloud initiatives across AWS and Google Cloud while remaining cloud-provider agnostic wherever practical.

• Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

• Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

• 10+ years of experience designing, supporting, and managing enterprise relational database platforms in production, with extensive experience operating in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices.

• Experience participating in incident response, root cause analysis, SRE initiatives, and implementing database DevOps practices like schema versioning and release automation.

• Experience mentoring engineers, influencing enterprise technical standards, and driving legacy database migrations (such as SQL Server) to cloud-native or open-source platforms.

• Experience supporting cloud-native applications, Kubernetes, or containerized workloads, ideally within SaaS, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries (preferred).

License/Certification Required:

• Microsoft SQL Server certification or equivalent experience.

• AWS or Google Cloud Professional certification (preferred)

title: Staff / Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Crawler

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the content acquisition and crawling infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that discover, fetch, and continuously refresh content from the open web and other large-scale data sources. You will design distributed crawling, scheduling, and ingestion infrastructure capable of operating at internet scale while balancing coverage, freshness, resource efficiency, and reliability. You will work on systems that process billions of URLs, manage high-throughput data flows, and ensure that high-quality content is consistently available to downstream indexing and retrieval systems.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

• Design, implement, and operate web-scale crawling systems for acquiring content from the internet

• Build ingestion workflows for internal and external data sources, including crawlers, structured feeds, and partner integrations

• Develop crawl scheduling, prioritisation, recrawl policies, and freshness strategies

• Build systems for URL discovery, deduplication, content extraction, and crawl orchestration

• Ensure reliable operation of crawling infrastructure under high-throughput conditions

• Define observability and quality metrics for crawl coverage, freshness, throughput, and content quality

• Monitor resource usage, bandwidth consumption, and infrastructure cost

• Collaborate with indexing and ML teams to ensure acquired content meets retrieval and ranking requirements

• Enable safe experimentation with crawling strategies and content acquisition policies

You may be a good fit if you:

• 5+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems

• Strong Go or C++ expertise 

• Experience with large-scale distributed systems (10k+ RPS, billions of URLs, high-throughput pipelines)

• Understanding of web protocols (HTTP, DNS, TLS), crawling, scraping, and content extraction

• Experience operating production systems and debugging failures in distributed environments

• Strong understanding of scalability, fault tolerance, and resource management

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

• Web crawling

• Building streaming data pipelines and event-driven systems

• Kafka, Pulsar, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms

• Designing distributed schedulers, queues, and asynchronous processing systems

• Spark, Flink, Beam, or MapReduce

• Ad tech, social networks, search engines, or other large-scale content platforms

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.
Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative

title: Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET)
description:

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET) to focus on our automation and manual testing of the suite of software products that we offer to customers. The candidate will be required to carry out tests to ensure the software we’re building addresses the business requirements and provides user friendly experience to our customers. The primary role is heavy on writing automated tests, maintaining them and triaging failures. This role will also include manual testing work for newer initiatives.
THE DAY-TO-DAY

• Define risk-based test plans and acceptance criteria in partnership with Product/Engineering; translate user stories into clear test cases.

• Build and maintain automated tests (Cypress/TypeScript preferred) across E2E, integration, and API layers; create reusable utilities/page objects and stabilize flaky tests.

• Implement and own CI/CD test gates (smoke/regression) with parallelization and clear pass/fail signals; track coverage and test health metrics.

• Perform targeted manual/exploratory testing for new features, edge cases, and UX flows; drive regression for critical paths.

• Create and manage test data, mocks/fixtures, and environment configurations to keep tests deterministic and fast.

• Coordinate with engineers to reproduce, triage, and debug issues using logs/metrics/trace tools; verify fixes and prevent regressions.

• Own post-deploy smoke testing and release sign-off for web apps and mobile apps; document results and risks.

• Continuously improve the QA/SDET toolchain and practices (coding standards, coverage goals, flake budgets, reporting dashboards).

WHAT MAKES YOU QUALIFIED

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software or related field (advanced degrees a plus).

• 5+ years in software testing with strong grounding in functional/regression and modern test design techniques (BC, EP, pairwise, etc.).

• Hands-on experience testing web applications and mobile apps end-to-end, including UX/UAT and bug verification across browsers/devices.

• 3+ years focused on test automation, including designing scalable frameworks and CI integration.

• Proficiency with Cypress (preferred) and JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with API testing (Postman/Newman, supertest, REST/GraphQL) and at least one additional tool (Playwright/WebdriverIO/Jest/Mocha).

• Comfortable with CI/CD (GitHub Actions/CircleCI/GitLab), Git, and basic Docker; familiarity with env management and secrets.

• Strong analytical skills; fluency with SDLC/Agile and tooling (Atlassian suite or similar).

• Ability to produce clear documentation (test plans, traceability, results) and communicate risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit/integration/E2E) with a focus on reliability and maintainability.

• Experience with Cypress specifically (selectors, fixtures, commands, intercepts, parallelization).

The position disclosed is a contract position looking to be filled immediately. The contractor will be expected to work during EST hours 9 AM - 5 PM EST (New York, USA).
This position is open to international applicants.

title: Datacenter Infrastructure Specialist
description:

More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on.

 

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

 

Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We are looking for a Datacenter Infrastructure Specialist to be the operational linchpin of our global fleet. Reporting to the Manager of Infrastructure Capacity & Management, you will serve as the technical authority bridging our hardware partners and internal engineering teams.

As our Datacenter Infrastructure Specialist, you will own the technical lifecycle and operational health of Runpod’s rapidly expanding, high-density GPU fleet. You will be part of a team that acts as the technical anchor for our hardware partners-serving as their infrastructure advisor, technical translator, adopter, and incident commander. This role blends deep HPC systems engineering, advanced network troubleshooting, and process automation to ensure rock-solid uptime for the world's most demanding AI workloads.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact position where you will move beyond traditional ticket-closing. You will work directly with cutting-edge GPU cloud technologies, advanced RDMA fabrics, and modern observability stacks to solve complex hardware challenges at scale. - Uptime & SLA Enforcement: Monitor fleet health to identify performance degradation. You will help audit downtime and provide the technical data needed to protect customer SLAs.

- AI-Driven Operations: We operate with an AI-first mindset, powering our operations with the technology we host. You will work with LLMs and AI agents to help automate network triage and generate dynamic runbooks for our fleet.

- Incident Support: Coordinate technical incident communications with clear updates, acting as a steady hand that translates outages into actionable resolutions.

- Partner Technical Support: Support the growth of our infrastructure partners

Requirements

- Professional Background: 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, systems reliability, or datacenter engineering.

- Datacenter Networking: Strong proficiency in standard datacenter networking and performance troubleshooting. Exposure to RDMA, InfiniBand, or RoCE is highly preferred.

- GPU & AI Stack: Hands-on experience with the NVIDIA Software Stack (driver installation, performance utilities) and an understanding of multi-node performance tuning.

- Systems & Diagnostics: Solid Linux system administration skills and experience with containerization (Docker). You are comfortable performing system-level troubleshooting and performance tuning at the kernel and hardware interface layers.

- Effective Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills. You can explain hardware or networking issues to both technical partners and internal leadership.

- Operational Flexibility: As our global fleet scales, this role may require participating in an on-call rotation in the future.

- Strategic Problem-Solver: You are detail-orient

title: Sr. "Rock Star" Web Developer For U.S. Digital Marketing Agency
description:
Gloss is a U.S. based digital marketing agency founded in 2007, and we've had a full-time Filipino staff since 2008.
We are seeking a full-time, senior level "Rock Star" Web Developer with at least 5 years experience who can work from home in the Philippines.
This is a dynamic and exciting position as you will lead our highly diverse development efforts in a fast-paced digital marketing environment.
It is absolutely imperative that you have at least 5 years experience and meet the qualifications in this job description.
We are only hiring top-notch "cream-of-the-crop" talent!
JOB DESCRIPTION
We have internal resources for design, copywriting and content creation, but the right candidate will be very comfortable leading the development effort and providing overall technical expertise in all phases of digital marketing, including the following:

•
Corporate Website: Ongoing site development and enhancement of our website

•
Email Marketing: Listbuilding, content creation, optimization, analytics, API development

•
Social Media Marketing & Promotion: Content distribution, organic traffic, paid traffic, optimization, analytics, API development

•
Content Marketing: Content creation, internal organization/process, distribution

•
Paid Advertising: Tracking, reporting, API development

JOB REQUIREMENTS
We are looking for top talent, so you must have the following skill sets (specifically in a digital marketing environment):

•
Expert level experience implementing Wordpress plugins, CSS, themes, templates, customization and API integration

•
Expert level experience implementing PHP, SQL, CSS, HTML and databases

•
Expert level experience implementing and deploying APIs

•
Proven ability working with tracking systems, analytics, conversion/pixel/postback tracking, and reporting

•
Proven ability in researching, recommending and implementing solutions to meet project requirements

•
Ability to manage multiple projects (with support from our full-time Filipino Project Manager)

• Your own computer and Internet connection

PERSONALITY REQUIREMENTS

• You'll have plenty of support (e.g. tools, resources, infrastructure, assistance from our VAs and more...), but you must have the mindset that you "own" your projects. If you're the type of person who waits to be told what to do at every step throughout a project, then this position isn't right for you.

• You'll be provided with very clear project instructions and requirements, but you must also be able to work independently, figure things out for yourself, do your own research when necessary, and adopt an attitude of "I'm going to do whatever it takes to get the job done!"

•
You must have a natural curiosity and passion for learning new technology, not just for the sake of the technology itself, but in how technology can be used to maximize the potential of our digital marketing efforts.

For example, we want someone who will (proactively) drill down into all of the features and functionality of software and tools we own and (proactively) tell us, e.g. "I discovered this feature we can implement to create a better user experience (or improve conversion rate, or increase ROI, or enhance operations, etc...).
COMPENSATION PACKAGE
Our goal is to work with professionals seeking long-term employment. We offer competitive pay and flexible hours. Compensation packages include the following:

• Guaranteed 100% On-Time Salary Payments

• 13th Month Bonus

• Paid National Holidays

• Raises & Performance Bonuses

title: Founding Operations Engineer (Legal)
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

- We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

- We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

- Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

- The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

- We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

- The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

- You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

- This is a legal role with heavy operational involvement and a requirement to build things. It is not a legal counsel role. You'll be qualified, you'll be able to act as counsel on day to day deal legals, but you'll sit close to the work and focus on streamlining / automating the systems generating the work in the first place.

- We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Microsoft Word or Docusign.

What you'll own

- Post-close and deal legals: You’ll own post-close: governance events, transfers, secondaries, distributions and exits. There is huge surface area for automation here too. You’ll also take care of the unusual issues where our documentation doesn't cleanly answer a question.

- Legal Reviews & Escalations: Every legal escalation coming out of the operations team.

- Automation: You'll work alongside the deal operations team, with a standing instruction to automate their work. You'll bring product/design/engineering into the things that genuinely need significant engineering work, but you’ll mainly work autonomously without them. Before it gets to them you've already made the process as simple and fast as possible, and usually vibe coded something that works well but perhaps needs to be stabilised / scaled.

- Managing external counsel: You’ll help decide what stays in-house, what goes out, and hold external advisers to account on cost and turnaround.

What we're looking for

- AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

- Qualified, with real deal legals experience: Funds, corporate, or financial services.

- In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard

title: Process Manager (Last Mile)
description:
At Rohlik, we own our end-to-end operations - from in-house technology and automated distribution centers to last-mile delivery. Delivering over 20,000 fresh and supermarket products same-day requires an operating model built on precision, cutting-edge automation, and data-driven decision-making.

As a Process Manager, Operations, you will be at the heart of optimizing and scaling this operational model across Central and Eastern Europe. You’ll sit right between business operations and product development, turning operational challenges into structured, high-performing processes and scalable technical solutions.

This is an analytical, highly hands-on role. You won’t just produce theoretical diagrams - you will spend time on the floor, analyze workflow data, design detailed process specifications for software developers, and ensure seamless rollouts across our multi-country fulfillment network.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-impact transformation: You will directly shape how our last-mile logistics operate as we scale across five European markets.

- Tech and automation focus: Work in an environment leveraging advanced warehouse automation, robotics, AI-driven decision systems, and autonomous last-mile delivery.

- Bridge operations and tech: Turn real-world fulfillment center friction into actionable engineering specifications and product roadmaps.

- Build for scale: Standardize methodologies across multiple sites while ensuring solutions are robust enough for rapid international expansion.

- Direct ownership: See the immediate operational impact of your work in metrics like cycle time, cost-per-order, and fulfillment accuracy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Process Analysis & Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes across fulfillment center and last-mile operations.

- Process Design & Specification: Develop and document detailed target process designs, translating business requirements into technical specs for Product Owners and developers.

- Methodological Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, VSM, and Ishikawa frameworks to streamline operational workflows.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Owners, software developers, engineering, and local operational teams to validate, test, and implement solutions.

- Business Case & KPI Tracking: Define process KPIs, build business cases (ROI, budgets, timelines), and track the measurable impact of improvements post-rollout.

- Implementation & Readiness: Write SOPs, prepare change management documentation, and support site teams to ensure smooth process rollouts.

- Continuous Improvement: Feed field insights into continuous improvement roadmaps and strategic operational initiatives.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2-3 years of experience in operations, process engineering, or JIT logistics within fast-paced environments (e-commerce, retail, automotive, or 3PL).

- Strong process toolbox: Hands-on mastery of methodologies and tools like VSM, DMAIC, Ishikawa, and SIPOC.

- Data-driven mindset: Strong analytical skills paired with advanced Excel capabilities (pivot tables, complex formulas) to evaluate KPIs and drive decisions.

- Tech-translating ability: Proven experience translating operational business requirements into clear process documentation for software engineering teams.

- Solid documentation skills: Experience producing clear SOPs, training materials, and change management frameworks.

- Language skills: English proficiency at B2 level minimum (written and spoken).

- Flexibility to travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% across our operational sites in 5 countries (Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania).

Nice-to-haves:

- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green/Black Belt).

- Working knowledge of SQL, BI tools, or statistical analysis software.

- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with software development teams.

- Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, or automated logistics systems.

Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

• No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

You're the second person in, owning events and content.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. The stories sit with underwriting, distribution and product, so getting good material out of busy people is a big part of the job.

AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. We want you to be the person who brings the newest tool into the office and shows everyone what it does. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own social media. Run our social strategy, with LinkedIn as the primary channel: product videos, carousels, infographics, and PDF’s, posted consistently and measured for engagement.

- Create content at volume. Case studies, articles, industry news, thought leadership and product launch material, several times a month.

- Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

- Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

- Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

- Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

- A portfolio of work you can share on the spot.

- Strong copywriting and communication, proven in published work.

- A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

- Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

- Startup pace and ownership: you've worked somewhere small enough to own outcomes end to end, spot what needs improving and act without waiting for a brief.

- Confident, critical use of AI across your marketing work.

Nice to have: video editing experience, and exposure to insurance, fleet or telematics.
